company.description: Soldo is a multi-user expense account that helps companies to manage the entire business expense cycle. It integrates prepaid mastercard cards, a web-based administration console, and a mobile app into one intuitive future-ready platform.

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-based platform for controlling, allocating, tracking, and reporting company spending across teams, departments, entities, and budgets.

productsAndServices.description: Tools for managing employee expenses and travel spending through approvals, receipt capture, categorization, policy controls, and real-time expense visibility.
productsAndServices.name: Soldo Expense and Travel & Entertainment Management

productsAndServices.description: A mobile application for employees and managers to request funds, check balances, capture receipts, track transactions, and submit expense information while on the go.

productsAndServices.description: Connectors and developer interfaces that synchronize Soldo spending data with accounting, ERP, HR, travel, eCommerce, and other business systems.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series C round raised $180,000,000, or 68.39% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $26,991,875 to $1,086,845,249, a 40.27x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 73 (-9 over 90 days) and market heat at 42 (-6).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
